limits: Bounded Linux/toolchain experiments; no physical target claim.
A successful reference run does not establish independent learner performance.
Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
Core C17 profile C; hosted allocated/adapter and measurement programs are profile A. No hosted dependencies enter the M4 image.
Actual unchanged reference providers, never learner artifacts; OwOwner comparison requires later PR-T66-01 and is excluded from P1 strict core.
Finite 8-action FIFO exploration and reduced generation retirement are separate; no unbounded proof.
Native LTO shared images are inspected, not executed without startup/guard initialization; four separate M4 images really execute.
Address interval ledger assumes native flat uintptr_t address order. Payload timing includes clock/assertion/read/copy/release work; initialization/backing allocation outside interval.
Arena64 byte capacity versus pool4 typed records plus nodes/control: different gross memory and different admission at length16. No misleading speed ranking.
External review, independent learner, seven-day attempt and physical observations remain absent.
